title: OpenSWMM Engine
description:
OpenSWMM Engine, developed by HydroCouple (github.com/HydroCouple/openswmm.engine), is an open-source hydrology, hydraulics and water-quality simulation engine for stormwater, wastewater and combined sewer systems. It is built on the EPA Storm Water Management Model (SWMM) 5.x and provides a reentrant C++20 engine, a public C API, Python bindings, two-dimensional surface flow and a command-line solver.

Portions are derived from EPA SWMM, which is in the public domain. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency does not endorse this software.
